Asset type: transparent production mascot for the Tingjian Mandarin learning app. Use the attached image only as a CHARACTER DESIGN reference: the navy-haired chibi Ado character, not the phone UI or cursor theme. Keep her recognizable to the supplied character, with clean expressive anime linework, restrained cel shading, soft rounded silhouette, two-and-a-half-head proportions. Premium polished illustration, friendly but not infantilized, no sexualization. EXACTLY ONE CHARACTER in a square canvas, entire hair, hands and feet visible, centered, feet around 88% canvas height, head around 12%, generous clear padding. True transparent background; no white rectangle, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork, no floor shadow, no sticker border, no text, no logo, no cursors, no arrows or pointer symbols. This is a welcoming state: she looks toward the viewer and waves gently with one hand, other hand relaxed near her chest. No extra props. Maintain dark navy and teal palette matching the reference.
